question: Does the 1997 JICA Laoag River Basin report provide site-resolved fish evidence for Paoay Lake or Laoag River?

source.title: The study on sabo and flood control in the Laoag River basin: final report, Vol. 3-1 — Supporting report, Appendix K
source.publisher: Japan International Cooperation Agency; CTI Engineering Co., Ltd.; Sanyu Consultants Inc.; Pasco International Inc.
source.relevantSection: Appendix K, Table K.2.3, 'Wild Fauna in Paoay Lake and Laoag River' (printed page K-20).
sourceAttributionPrinted: Office of Paoay Lake National Park (for wild fauna)

scope.reportContext: Appendix K is part of a Laoag River Basin flood-control study. The report text describes the table as wild fauna observed in Paoay Lake National Park and fishes caught in Laoag River and offshore.
scope.fieldPeriod: Not reported for the fauna table. The report's 1997 publication date is not treated as the observation or collection date.
scope.dataType: A secondary summary of common and local-name labels grouped under freshwater, brackish-water, and offshore headings.
scope.localityResolution: The narrative mentions Paoay Lake National Park and Laoag River/offshore, but Table K.2.3 has no waterbody, station, or event column that assigns each fish label to an exact site.
scope.taxonomicResolution: The table gives no scientific names, identifiers, specimen or voucher references, counts, or fish-specific collection methods. The printed 'Fish' category also includes a freshwater shrimp label.

assessment.interpretation: This is useful historical source-tracing and vernacular-name context only. It cannot support taxon-level occurrence at Paoay Lake or Laoag River, a full fish inventory, population status, diet, catchability, safety, or fishing-rule claims.
assessment.reuseFinding: The JICA catalog page carries a JICA copyright notice and no item-specific open license was identified. No table, image, or list of names was reproduced in this review.

disposition.reason: The historical table contains only broad common/local names and cannot separate fish labels among Paoay Lake, Laoag River and offshore settings or tie them to dated, method-described fish events.

nextAction: Seek the underlying Office of Paoay Lake National Park or Provincial Agricultural Office fauna records, or an independent fish survey with scientific identifications and waterbody-resolved events. Keep this table as unresolved historical context and do not convert its labels into app species records.
